name: Kinga Kollár - Après le § 30 - Am 1
title: REPORT on the EU’s approach to corporate tax policy in a changing international environment
part_text: 30a. Notes with concern that, since the war in the Gulf region broke out and the Strait of Hormuz was closed, the profits of oil and gas companies have skyrocketed, while energy bills for households and European businesses have increased sharply; calls on the Commission to put forward without delay a proposal to tax consolidated excess profits of large oil and gas companies; stresses that revenues from such a measure should be used to provide targeted support to households and SMEs, and to contribute to reducing the EU’s dependence on fossil fuels and accelerating the sustainable energy transition;
